title: Single hieratic sign, Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 9010 (AKU HT 9600)

object.name: Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 9010

source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 9600

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 9600; AKU grapheme G0840 (AKU GR 287). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: G37 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 197, 197 (v4p8). Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 19, no. 197. Occurrence: find place Elephantine; writing direction "Kolumnen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 7.3 x 11 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 6. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
